title: Canonical derived extension-by-zero normalization at the identity
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a scheme. Let $\Lambda_X$ be its pulled-back coefficient ring and let $(\mathrm{id}_X)_!$ be the exact module-object extension by zero of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]. Use the ordinary derived-category conventions of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Define the canonical natural isomorphism $\eta_X:D((\mathrm{id}_X)_!)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{Id}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})}$ as follows. The underived isomorphism $(\mathrm{id}_X)_!\cong\mathrm{Id}$ is the unique left-adjoint comparison between $(\mathrm{id}_X)_!\dashv(\mathrm{id}_X)^*$, transported by the canonical pullback identity isomorphism, and $\mathrm{Id}\dashv\mathrm{Id}$. Apply the levelwise derived functor to that natural isomorphism and then compose with the canonical derived identity-functor isomorphism. This specifies the identity normalization used for the trivial compactification of a proper morphism.
